cloudflare-basin-catalog:rest-spec-suppo.notes: Exposes a standard Iceberg REST catalog interface on each R2 bucket (formerly R2 Data Catalog), with a catalog URI and warehouse name used by any REST-compatible Iceberg client. Bearer-token auth and the X-Iceberg-Access-Delegation: vended-credentials header are supported.
caveats: View endpoints of the Iceberg REST spec are not supported
R2 buckets in a non-default jurisdiction are not supported

cloudflare-basin-catalog:v2-spec-support.notes: Serves format v2 tables, including row-level deletes in both copy-on-write and merge-on-read modes (position/equality delete files), which managed compaction applies when rewriting data files.
caveats: Managed compaction only rewrites Parquet data files

cloudflare-basin-catalog:v3-spec-support.notes: Format v3 tables (deletion vectors, row lineage, variant and geospatial types) are not supported; tables are format v2.

cloudflare-basin-catalog:managed-offerin.notes: Generally available, fully managed catalog built into R2 buckets: enabled per bucket from the dashboard, Wrangler or Terraform, with managed compaction, manifest optimization and snapshot expiration. No egress fees for engines reading from other clouds.

cloudflare-basin-catalog:serves-own-irc:.notes: Serves its own tables read and write over the Iceberg REST API to external engines, vending short-lived SigV4 credentials for the underlying R2 data files. Read-only and read-write API tokens are supported.
caveats: Vended credentials inherit the R2 storage permissions of the authenticating API token rather than being scoped to a single table path

cloudflare-basin-catalog:rw-foreign-irc:.notes: No documented support for reading or writing tables governed by an external catalog. The bundled engine, Basin SQL, queries tables in Basin Catalog only.

cloudflare-basin-catalog:federation-brok.notes: Not a meta-catalog: each catalog serves the Iceberg tables in its own R2 bucket and does not federate external catalogs.

cloudflare-basin-catalog:multi-engine-mu.notes: Broad engine compatibility with documented setups for Spark, Trino, DuckDB, PyIceberg, Snowflake and StarRocks, and zero-egress access from compute in any cloud. Table storage is R2 only.
caveats: Tables must live in R2; storage in other clouds is not supported

cloudflare-basin-catalog:governance-cred.notes: Catalog-vended, short-lived SigV4 credentials and read-only or read-write API tokens scoped per bucket. No namespace- or table-level RBAC, column masking or row/column policies are documented.
caveats: Vended credentials carry the token's bucket-level R2 permissions rather than per-table path scoping
